description: Hierarchical vocabulary for tagging environmental and architectural images in environmental psychology research. Grounded in vision science (Gibson 1979, Appleton 1975), aesthetic theory (Berlyne 1971), and landscape perception (Kaplan & Kaplan 1989, Ulrich 1983).

key_references.title: The Experience of Nature: A Psychological Perspective
Aesthetic and Affective Response to Natural Environment
The Ecological Approach to Visual Perception

domains.description: Volumetric, boundary, and enclosure characteristics of environmental spaces

attributes.name: Perceived Volume/Spaciousness
attributes.unit: relative scale (0-100) or m³ if known
attributes.description: Subjective experience of spatial volume; integration of ceiling height, floor area, and visual flow
attributes.assessment_method: Visual estimation; can be verified with architectural plans or photogrammetry
attributes.reliability_notes: Inter-rater reliability moderate to good (ICC ~0.65-0.80) for trained raters; affected by lighting and visual complexity

attributes.name: Degree of Enclosure
attributes.description: Extent to which space is bounded by walls, vegetation, or other barriers
attributes.assessment_method: Identify major architectural/landscape elements defining the boundary; classify based on degree of visual closure
attributes.reliability_notes: High inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.80-0.90) when clear architectural boundaries present; lower when vegetation defines boundaries

attributes.name: Prospect (Visual Access/View Distance)
attributes.description: Distance and clarity of sightlines; ability to see distant objects and vistas
attributes.assessment_method: Measure longest clear sightline; estimate distance of furthest visible object
attributes.reliability_notes: Good inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.75) for natural scenes; affected by haze, vegetation, lighting conditions

attributes.name: Mystery/Visual Intrigue
attributes.description: Degree to which space suggests hidden information, incomplete knowledge, or incentive to explore
valid_values: high (significant hidden information, strong exploratory pull)
attributes.assessment_method: Identify visual occlusions, curves, and spatial transitions that suggest hidden information
attributes.reliability_notes: Moderate inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.60-0.70); subjective interpretation required

attributes.name: Wayfinding Legibility
attributes.description: Clarity of spatial structure; ease of understanding layout and navigation
attributes.assessment_method: Identify presence of landmarks, clear circulation paths, and visual hierarchy
attributes.reliability_notes: Good inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.75) with clear architectural structure

domains.description: Natural and artificial light properties including intensity, color temperature, and distribution

attributes.name: Primary Light Source
attributes.description: Dominant light source(s) in the environment
attributes.assessment_method: Visual inspection; identify shadows, glare, and light direction
attributes.reliability_notes: High inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.85) for clear daylight vs. artificial distinction

attributes.name: Illuminance Level
attributes.description: Light intensity; can be measured with light meter
attributes.assessment_method: Measured with illuminance meter (lux meter) at multiple points; visual estimation if meter unavailable
attributes.reliability_notes: Very high reliability with instrumentation (±5%); visual estimation moderate (ICC ~0.60)

attributes.name: Color Temperature
attributes.description: Warmth/coolness of light; perceived color of the light source
theoretical_grounding: Affective response to warm vs. cool light
attributes.assessment_method: Measured with color temperature meter; visual estimation comparing to reference standards
attributes.reliability_notes: Good reliability with colorimeter (±100K); visual estimation moderate (ICC ~0.65)

attributes.name: Light Distribution Uniformity
attributes.description: Even distribution of light across space vs. spotty, glare-prone distribution
attributes.assessment_method: Compare illuminance at multiple points (center, corners, under fixtures)
attributes.reliability_notes: Moderate inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.65); affected by viewing angle

attributes.name: Shadow Characteristics
attributes.description: Presence, sharpness, and quality of shadows
theoretical_grounding: Visual perception of depth and form
attributes.assessment_method: Observe shadow edges and intensity gradients
attributes.reliability_notes: Good inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.75) for clear categories

domains.description: Physical composition of visible surfaces; tactile and visual texture properties

attributes.name: Dominant Material Categories
attributes.description: Primary materials visible (rough surfaces for assessment)
attributes.assessment_method: Visual identification of surface materials in foreground and middle ground
attributes.reliability_notes: High inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.80) for clearly visible materials

attributes.name: Natural vs. Synthetic Material Ratio
attributes.description: Proportion of visible surface area composed of natural materials
attributes.measurement_guidance: 0%=all synthetic/processed; 50%=mixed equal; 100%=all natural (wood, stone, plants, earth)
attributes.assessment_method: Estimate visible surface area by material category; compute natural fraction
attributes.reliability_notes: Moderate inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.65-0.70); depends on viewing distance

attributes.name: Surface Finish Quality
attributes.description: Smoothness, wear, and maintenance state of visible surfaces
attributes.assessment_method: Examine surface condition, visibility of wear, maintenance signs
attributes.reliability_notes: Good inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.75) when clear wear patterns present

attributes.name: Visual Texture Complexity
attributes.unit: relative scale (0-100) or fractal dimension if computed
attributes.description: Richness and intricacy of surface texture patterns
attributes.measurement_guidance: 0=smooth blank wall; 50=wood grain or regular pattern; 100=complex natural texture (bark, stone, foliage)
attributes.assessment_method: Visual inspection or algorithmic texture analysis (e.g., box-counting fractal dimension)
attributes.reliability_notes: Moderate inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.60-0.70) for visual estimation; high with algorithmic analysis

domains.description: Presence, type, density, and visibility of living plants and natural elements

attributes.name: Vegetation Presence/Visibility
attributes.description: Degree to which living vegetation is visible in the scene
attributes.assessment_method: Estimate proportion of visible plant/vegetation area
attributes.reliability_notes: Good inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.75) for clear vegetation gradients

attributes.name: Vegetation Categories
attributes.description: Types of plants present (non-exclusive)
attributes.assessment_method: Identify plant types visible in foreground and middle-ground
attributes.reliability_notes: High inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.80) for clear plant identification

attributes.name: Foliage Density
attributes.unit: percentage of canopy cover (0-100) or relative scale
attributes.description: Density of leaves and branches; degree of canopy occlusion
attributes.measurement_guidance: 0=no foliage; 33%=sparse trees/shrubs; 67%=moderate dappled shade; 100%=dense closed canopy
attributes.assessment_method: Visual estimation of canopy closure; can use densiometer for quantification
attributes.reliability_notes: Moderate inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.65-0.70) for visual estimation; high with densiometer

attributes.name: Vegetation Health/Vitality
attributes.description: Visual signs of health; verdancy and vigor of plants
attributes.assessment_method: Assess leaf color, growth vigor, absence of disease signs
attributes.reliability_notes: Good inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.75) when clear health differences present

attributes.name: Vegetation Spatial Arrangement
attributes.description: Pattern and distribution of vegetation in the scene
attributes.assessment_method: Describe spatial distribution pattern
attributes.reliability_notes: Moderate inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.65) for pattern identification

domains.description: Color palette, saturation, contrast, and chromatic properties

attributes.name: Dominant Color Hues
attributes.description: Primary colors in the scene (non-exclusive)
attributes.assessment_method: Identify dominant color categories in composition
attributes.reliability_notes: Good inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.75) for clear color identification

attributes.name: Overall Color Saturation
attributes.unit: relative scale (0-100) or HSL saturation measure
attributes.description: Intensity and vividness of colors; richness vs. paleness
attributes.assessment_method: Visual estimation or algorithmic HSL analysis
attributes.reliability_notes: Moderate inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.60-0.70) for visual estimation

attributes.name: Chromatic Contrast
attributes.unit: relative scale (0-100) or delta-E color difference
attributes.description: Degree of color differentiation; distinction between colored regions
attributes.assessment_method: Visual inspection of color variety or algorithmic contrast analysis
attributes.reliability_notes: Moderate inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.60-0.70)

attributes.name: Warm vs. Cool Color Ratio
attributes.description: Balance between warm (red/orange/yellow) and cool (blue/green/purple) tones
attributes.assessment_method: Estimate proportion of warm vs. cool colored areas
attributes.reliability_notes: Moderate inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.65)

attributes.name: Color Palette Naturalness
attributes.description: Degree to which colors reflect natural scenes vs. artificial palette
valid_values: highly-natural (rich natural palette, full saturation of nature colors)
attributes.assessment_method: Compare palette to natural landscape color ranges
attributes.reliability_notes: Good inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.75) with naturalism training

domains.description: Perceived intricacy, detail level, and information content in the image

attributes.name: Visual Complexity
attributes.description: Amount of detail, variation, and intricacy in the visual scene
attributes.measurement_guidance: 0=minimal (blank wall); 50=moderate (some variation, moderate detail); 100=highly complex (rich detail, many elements)
attributes.assessment_method: Visual estimation or algorithmic complexity analysis (entropy, fractal dimension)
attributes.reliability_notes: Moderate inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.60-0.70) for visual estimation; high with algorithmic methods

attributes.name: Clutter vs. Organization
attributes.description: Degree to which scene feels organized and ordered vs. chaotic and cluttered
theoretical_grounding: Preference for moderate complexity with structure
attributes.assessment_method: Assess visual hierarchy, grouping, and organizational structure
attributes.reliability_notes: Good inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.75) for clear ordering patterns

attributes.name: Information Density
attributes.unit: estimated bits per degree of visual angle or relative scale (0-100)
attributes.description: Amount of distinct visual information per unit area
attributes.measurement_guidance: 0=sparse/redundant information; 50=moderate density; 100=high density of distinct details
attributes.assessment_method: Count distinct objects/regions; estimate informational content
attributes.reliability_notes: Moderate inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.60-0.70)

attributes.name: Pattern Coherence
attributes.description: Degree to which visual elements form coherent patterns vs. appearing random
attributes.assessment_method: Identify repeating elements, symmetries, and organizational patterns
attributes.reliability_notes: Moderate inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.65-0.70)

domains.description: Spatial depth, visual layering, and perceptual distance cues

attributes.name: Depth Cue Richness
attributes.description: Number and strength of visual cues indicating three-dimensional depth
valid_values: rich (multiple depth cues: perspective, occlusion, size, lighting)
attributes.assessment_method: Identify perspective lines, occlusion, size gradients, motion parallax
attributes.reliability_notes: Good inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.75) for clear depth structures

attributes.name: Visual Layering/Depth Planes
attributes.description: Number of distinct visual depth planes or layers
attributes.assessment_method: Identify distinct foreground/middle-ground/background regions
attributes.reliability_notes: Good inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.75) for clear depth planes

attributes.name: Focal Point Clarity
attributes.description: Presence and strength of a clear visual center of attention
valid_values: absent (no clear focal point, equal visual weight)
attributes.assessment_method: Identify where eyes naturally rest; assess visual prominence
attributes.reliability_notes: Moderate inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.65-0.70)

attributes.name: Vertical/Horizontal Balance
attributes.description: Balance between vertical (sky/ceiling) and horizontal (ground/floor) composition
valid_values: sky-dominant (tall image, emphasis on upper portion)
ground-dominant (wide/low image, emphasis on lower portion)
attributes.assessment_method: Estimate visual weight of sky vs. ground areas
attributes.reliability_notes: Good inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.75) for compositions with clear division

attributes.name: Visual Flow and Rhythm
attributes.description: Presence of visual pathways that guide eye movement through composition
valid_values: strong-flow (compelling visual rhythm, guided eye movement)
attributes.assessment_method: Trace eye path through image; identify leading lines, curves, diagonals
attributes.reliability_notes: Moderate inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.65-0.70)

domains.description: Built vs. natural environment, setting type, and contextual features

attributes.name: Built vs. Natural Environment Ratio
attributes.description: Proportion of scene composed of artificial/built structures vs. natural elements
attributes.assessment_method: Estimate visible area occupied by buildings, roads, infrastructure vs. nature
attributes.reliability_notes: Good inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.75) for clear built/natural distinction

attributes.name: Environmental Setting Type
attributes.description: Broad category of environment
attributes.assessment_method: Identify primary environmental category from visual cues
attributes.reliability_notes: High inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.85) for distinct setting types

attributes.name: Human Scale and Proportion
attributes.description: Degree to which environmental elements fit human body proportions and movement
valid_values: inhuman-scale (elements far too large or small for human)
attributes.assessment_method: Compare visible elements (doorways, windows, furniture) to typical human dimensions
attributes.reliability_notes: Good inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.75) with knowledge of human proportions

attributes.name: Physical Accessibility and Navigability
attributes.description: Ease of physical movement and access within the environment
attributes.assessment_method: Identify visible paths, barriers, obstacles, and accessibility features
attributes.reliability_notes: Moderate inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.65-0.70)

attributes.name: Evidence of Human Activity/Use
attributes.description: Visible signs of ongoing or habitual human use and occupation
attributes.assessment_method: Look for people, wear patterns, objects, modifications indicating use
attributes.reliability_notes: Good inter-rater reliability (ICC ~0.75) for clear activity evidence

domain_summary_scores.description: Computed aggregate scores for each domain, combining component attributes

naturalness.description: Overall sense of natural vs. artificial character (0=fully artificial, 100=fully natural)
naturalness.computation: weighted average of vegetation-presence, materials-naturalness-ratio, color-naturalness, environment-built-natural-ratio

visual-complexity.computation: weighted average of complexity-visual, spatial-volume, lighting-color-temperature, vegetation-density

prospect-refuge-index.description: Balance of openness (prospect) and enclosure (refuge) (0=only refuge, 50=balanced, 100=only prospect)
prospect-refuge-index.computation: weighted difference between prospect and enclosure_degree

restorative-capacity.description: Overall capacity to support stress reduction and attention restoration (0=non-restorative, 100=highly restorative)
restorative-capacity.computation: weighted average of naturalness, vegetation-presence, lighting-source-type, view-depth-cues, materials-naturalness-ratio

human-centeredness.description: Orientation toward human comfort and accessibility (0=inhospitable, 100=highly accommodating)
human-centeredness.computation: weighted average of environment-scale-human, environment-accessibility, materials-surface-finish, lighting-uniformity

general_workflow: 1. Examine image in full; take overview assessment
2. For each domain, assess applicable attributes
3. Start with easy objective measures (lighting-illuminance, vegetation-presence)
5. Compute domain summary scores if sufficient attributes tagged
6. Cross-check for internal consistency (e.g., high naturalness with zero vegetation is unlikely)

inter_rater_protocol.reliability_measure: Intraclass Correlation Coefficient (ICC(3,1) two-way mixed effects)
inter_rater_protocol.resolution_for_disagreement: Median of rater values for continuous attributes; mode for categorical; discussion required if ICC < 0.60

cultural_considerations.description: Some attributes may have cultural variations in perception
cultural_considerations.note: Record rater cultural context if available; consider culturally-stratified norms in aggregation

validation_rules.rule: naturalness score > 80 should have vegetation-presence ≥ moderate
validation_rules.rationale: Natural scenes typically include visible vegetation

validation_rules.rule: environment-built-natural-ratio > 80 implies environment-setting-type not in [natural-wilderness, natural-managed-park]
spatial-volume > 80 and spatial-enclosure-degree = completely-enclosed are contradictory

completeness_requirements.minimum_attributes: At least 50% of applicable domain attributes tagged
completeness_requirements.optional_attributes: Complex attributes (complexity-visual, view-depth-cues) optional if rater lack specialized training
